notes.notes:
Add some expansion mini games, which can be expanded by clicking the button in the upper right corner of the main menu interface
List of mini games: Gomoku, Void Dragon, Eight Gates, Pyramid Card Game, Snake Greed, Ten Steps Ten Thousand Degrees, Continuous Watching, Tetris, Sudoku, Escape from Maze, Number Huarong Dao, Five Sons Lianzhu
Note: Mini games may not have complete mechanisms and are only for entertainment purposes
